visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Iteration Instead of Exponential Recursion
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This recursive fib makes hundreds of thousands of calls for fib(27). Rewrite it with a loop. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The recursive version recomputes the same values over and over, so its work grows exponentially. The loop computes each Fibonacci number once, which takes n steps.
